description: Guard tests and the production sources they guard. A commit that changes both sides of a pair approves itself: the widened guard test can no longer fail the change the commit allows. Split the commit instead (guard test first, source change second). Paths are repo-relative, forward slashes; a test may guard several sources. The guard's own test file (tests/ci/test_check_self_approving_commit.py) is deliberately NOT registered: registering it would make the guard flag the very commit that adds it.
